title: Anagama Woodfire Workshop
source_quote: Anagama Woodfire Workshop April 4 @ 9:30 am - May 9 @ 4:00 pm
evidence_sentence: This hands-on workshop focuses on firing the Japanese-style Anagama wood kiln; participants sign up for shifts during loading and firing.
evidence_quote: This hands-on workshop focuses on the principals of firing the Japanese-style Anagama wood kiln
summary: A five-week workshop in spring 2026 where you fire up to 4 cubic feet of bisque work in the anagama kiln. You bring your work, attend wood-prep and loading days, and work crew shifts round-the-clock during the firing. Cost $325; free tent camping available.
bring: bisque-fired ceramic work (up to 4 cubic feet), work clothes, closed-toed shoes, jeans, heavy work gloves
commitment: April 4 prep day, April 22 drop-off, April 23-27 loading, April 28-May 2 firing round-the-clock, May 9 unloading
how_to_join: Register online at the link on the workshop page using a credit card, or contact sceinfo@uwm.edu for other payment options.
pay_text: $325 fee; also requires crew shifts during loading and firing
